cli-workflow-extraction.name: cli-workflow-extraction
cli-workflow-extraction.description: Extract preflight, host lifecycle, run execution and rendering from cli/main.py.

action_steps.title: Extract preflight and host lifecycle into services
action_steps.detail: Create lm_optimizer/services/host_lifecycle.py and move _connect_guarded, _preflight_optimize and host cleanup there; keep thin console wrappers in lm_optimizer/cli/main.py.

action_steps.title: Move run execution and report rendering into a workflow service
action_steps.detail: Create lm_optimizer/services/optimization_workflow.py that calls prepare_run/execute and returns a result object; lm_optimizer/cli/main.py renders that object.

action_steps.title: Thin the Typer command bodies to parse/compose/render adapters
action_steps.detail: In lm_optimizer/cli/main.py, reduce the optimize and auto command bodies to argument parsing, one workflow call and console rendering; target under 150 lines each.

action_steps.title: Add regression tests for the extracted workflow service
action_steps.detail: Add tests/test_optimization_workflow.py covering prepare -> execute -> report with fakes; assert lm_optimizer/cli/main.py calls the workflow service once.

settings-boundary-typing.name: settings-boundary-typing
settings-boundary-typing.description: One typed AdvancedSettings boundary and BenchmarkService factory.

action_steps.title: Define AdvancedSettings at the CLI/API boundary
action_steps.detail: Add lm_optimizer/services/advanced_settings.py with a typed AdvancedSettings model; construct it once in api/routes.py start_optimization and cli/main.py _optimize_advanced.

action_steps.title: Add build_benchmark_service(settings) and use it from CLI and API
action_steps.detail: Add build_benchmark_service(settings) to lm_optimizer/services/benchmark.py and call it from lm_optimizer/cli/main.py and lm_optimizer/api/routes.py so defaults cannot drift.

action_steps.title: Type defaults/duel payloads with TypedDicts
action_steps.detail: Replace dict[str, Any] in lm_optimizer/services/lmstudio_defaults.py and lm_optimizer/services/duel.py with TypedDicts; keep raw JSON only at the file/HTTP edge.

action_steps.title: Normalize skip phases to enums internally
action_steps.detail: In lm_optimizer/services/optimizer.py parse skip phases once in parse_phase_skips and compare OptimizationPhase members; convert strings only at the CLI/JSON boundary.

error-handling-audit.name: error-handling-audit
error-handling-audit.description: Replace copied silent catches with one logged best-effort helper.

action_steps.title: Add a best-effort helper that logs with exc_info
action_steps.detail: Add lm_optimizer/services/best_effort.py with a helper that logs at debug with exc_info and a context message, then returns None.

action_steps.title: Replace copied except/pass blocks in optimizer and routes
action_steps.detail: In lm_optimizer/services/optimizer.py (41 blocks), lm_optimizer/api/routes.py (30) and lm_optimizer/cli/main.py (14), replace except/pass with the logged best-effort helper where failure is tolerated.

action_steps.title: Document the layer error contract (clients raise, services return outcomes)
action_steps.detail: Document the layer contract in lm_optimizer/services/lm_studio.py and lm_optimizer/services/benchmark.py: clients raise, services return outcome objects, repositories return None; add Raises sections.

action_steps.title: Flatten retry and success-condition branches
action_steps.detail: In lm_optimizer/services/optimizer.py and lm_optimizer/services/lm_studio.py, drive retries from one attempt function and one loop; add is_successful(run) in lm_optimizer/services/run_summary.py.

api-contracts.name: api-contracts
api-contracts.description: Response models, one error mapping and one presenter path.

action_steps.title: Add response models to the untyped routes
action_steps.detail: Add Pydantic response schemas in lm_optimizer/api/schemas.py for status, models, runs, progress and presets, then set response_model on the matching handlers in lm_optimizer/api/routes.py.

action_steps.title: Add one exception-to-HTTP mapping layer
action_steps.detail: Add an exception-to-HTTP mapping layer in lm_optimizer/api/main.py (middleware or dependency) and raise typed domain errors from lm_optimizer/api/routes.py instead of ad-hoc HTTPException(500).

action_steps.title: Consolidate config response enrichment into one presenter
action_steps.detail: Consolidate config response enrichment in lm_optimizer/api/routes.py into one presenter that returns the full ConfigurationResultResponse; remove _enrich_config_detail dict mutation.

action_steps.title: Replace manual route registration with a supported pattern
action_steps.detail: In lm_optimizer/api/main.py replace the manual APIRoute recreation with include_router on a pinned FastAPI version, and add a startup assertion for route count and /api prefixes.

services-structure.name: services-structure
services-structure.description: Split the flat services package and retire the legacy client boundary.

action_steps.title: Split services/ into capability subpackages
action_steps.detail: Split lm_optimizer/services/ into orchestration, benchmarking, persistence, reporting and host_lifecycle subpackages; keep a small compatibility facade in services/__init__.py.

action_steps.title: Split domain/models.py by aggregate
action_steps.detail: Split lm_optimizer/domain/models.py into hardware.py, configuration.py, benchmark.py and run.py, then re-export the names from lm_optimizer/domain/__init__.py.

action_steps.title: Port discovery/inspector.py to services/lm_studio.py
action_steps.detail: Port lm_optimizer/discovery/inspector.py from lm_optimizer/api/client.py to lm_optimizer/services/lm_studio.py; delete api/client.py after tests/test_persistence_loop_* migrate.

action_steps.title: Move current-run globals into app.state
action_steps.detail: In lm_optimizer/api/routes.py replace _current_optimizer and _current_run_id globals with a RunRegistry stored on app.state and injected from the lifespan in lm_optimizer/api/main.py.

report-and-test-config.name: report-and-test-config
report-and-test-config.description: Split the report builder and the 244-line _test_config.

action_steps.title: Extract report section builders that return lines
action_steps.detail: In lm_optimizer/services/reporting.py extract one section builder per report block that returns lines; make save_best_report compose them while keeping output byte-identical.

action_steps.title: Split _test_config into load/measure/evaluate/record steps
action_steps.detail: In lm_optimizer/services/optimizer.py split _test_config into load_candidate, measure_candidate, evaluate_candidate and record_candidate, then compose them in _test_config.

tests-conventions.name: tests-conventions
tests-conventions.description: Choose a canonical test root and add transport-level contract tests.

action_steps.title: Choose one canonical test root or document unit vs integration markers
action_steps.detail: Document tests/ as the canonical root in pyproject.toml and README, add unit/integration pytest markers, and enforce the layout in CI.

action_steps.title: Add httpx.MockTransport contract tests for LM Studio and Ollama
action_steps.detail: Add tests/test_lm_studio_transport.py and tests/test_ollama_transport.py using httpx.MockTransport for timeout, 4xx/5xx and malformed payloads.

action_steps.title: Document the dataclass vs Pydantic boundary
action_steps.detail: Document in README that lm_optimizer/domain/models.py uses dataclasses internally and lm_optimizer/api/schemas.py uses Pydantic only at the HTTP edge; make BenchmarkConfig typed.

action_steps.title: Enforce the chosen layout in CI
action_steps.detail: Add a CI path check or pytest marker enforcement so new tests cannot be added to the wrong root; update pyproject.toml markers.

strategist_briefing.executive_summary: The repository moved from a duplicated legacy stack to a single orchestration and web path, which removed both import cycles, the deprecated UI/engine/checkpoint modules and the unmaintained GPUtil dependency. Strict score improved from 68.4 to 70.2 and the full suite is green at 1,494 tests. The remaining drag is concentrated rather than systemic: the CLI and services packages are too large, the advanced-settings handoff is still an untyped dict, and broad silent catches hide failures in orchestration paths. The next phase should split responsibilities along existing seams and type the public service boundary before attempting cosmetic cleanup in tools/ or docs.
strategist_briefing.observe_guidance: Verify claims against the current tree rather than the previous review: the legacy stack, cycles and GPUtil are gone, so focus observation on cli/main.py, services/optimizer.py and api/routes.py where size and error handling still concentrate risk.
strategist_briefing.reflect_guidance: Prioritize high_level_elegance, mid_level_elegance, type_safety and design_coherence; avoid re-litigating resolved migration findings and avoid churning tools/ scripts.
strategist_briefing.organize_guidance: Order work by blast radius: first extract the shared optimization workflow from the CLI, then introduce a typed AdvancedSettings boundary, then reduce silent catches in optimizer/routes. Keep api/client deletion blocked until discovery is ported.
strategist_briefing.sense_check_guidance: The highest risk is score-neutral churn in large files without reducing responsibility count. Prefer one structural extraction per file over scattered renames, and do not add abstraction layers that only forward arguments.
